_comment: Landmark world-frame map. This file DEFINES the world frame: every marker (x,y) is a surveyed constant, and target_B is a fixed point in the same frame. Units: meters, degrees. Edit here to re-survey a site -- no code change needed.

camera_extrinsic._comment: Camera pose in the drone body frame (T_BC). rpy=[180,0,0] => camera looks straight down (optical Z points at the ground).
